intro: Place simulated buy and sell orders across crypto, stocks, ETFs, forex and commodities with $100,000 in virtual cash. Quotes and charts may use provider data, delayed prices or simulated values. Check the source and freshness labels for each input where available. (Educational simulation only — not financial advice.)

priorFAQ.question: Is the TradeHQ trading simulator free to use?
priorFAQ.answer: Yes. TradeHQ lets guests practise with $100,000 in virtual cash without signup or a credit card. There are no real-money charges; simulated buy and sell orders include a 0.1% virtual transaction fee. (Educational simulation only — not financial advice.)

priorFAQ.question: How do I start practice trading?
priorFAQ.answer: Choose an asset from the market cards or asset selector, set a virtual order size, then select Buy or Sell. Guest orders are stored in this browser; signed-in account orders and cash/positions are server-recorded when the service is available.
